//: Editor/CI type checking for the unit tests. Deliberately does NOT extend the
SDK's tsconfig.ecs7.json: that sets `types` to an allowlist containing only
@dcl/js-runtime, which leaves vitest's globals and Node's unresolved. The
scene's own tsconfig.json only includes src/ and assets/, so `npm run
typecheck` never sees these files and stays exactly as strict as before.
